description: Positional distribution of pathogenic truncating RAD51D alleles along the coding sequence, with NMD-escape depletion test
code:
import requests, re, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats
H={"User-Agent":"openscientist/1.0 (research)"}
EUT="https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/"
term='RAD51D[gene] AND ("clinsig pathogenic"[Properties] OR "clinsig likely pathogenic"[Properties])'
ids=requests.get(EUT+"esearch.fcgi",params={"db":"clinvar","term":term,"retmode":"json","retmax":500},headers=H,timeout=50).json()["esearchresult"]["idlist"]
names=[]
for i in range(0,len(ids),150):
    j=requests.post(EUT+"esummary.fcgi",data={"db":"clinvar","id":",".join(ids[i:i+150]),"retmode":"json"},headers=H,timeout=50).json()["result"]
    for k_ in j.get("uids",[]):
        names.append(j[k_].get("variation_set",[{}])[0].get("variation_name",""))

cds_len=[81,165,71,91,96,135,82,119,62,82]; CDS=sum(cds_len)
cum=np.cumsum(cds_len); bounds=np.concatenate([[0],cum])
last_junction=int(cum[-2]); nmd_escape=last_junction-50
print("CDS nt:",CDS,"| last exon-exon junction:",last_junction,"| NMD-escape starts at nt",nmd_escape)

pos=[]
for n in names:
    if "NM_002878.4(RAD51D):c." not in n: continue
    cpart=n.split(":c.")[1].split(" (p.")[0]
    if "*" in cpart: continue                      # 3'UTR-spanning
    if re.search(r"\d[+-]\d", cpart): continue     # intronic splice-site coordinates
    if ("fs" not in n) and ("Ter" not in n): continue
    m=re.match(r"(\d+)(?:_(\d+))?", cpart)
    if not m: continue
    p=int(m.group(1))
    if m.group(2) and int(m.group(2))-p>100: continue   # exclude multi-exon deletions
    if 1<=p<=CDS: pos.append(p)
pos=np.array(sorted(set(pos)))
print(f"unique small truncating P/LP alleles mapped to CDS: n={len(pos)}")

ks=stats.kstest(pos/CDS,'uniform')
print(f"KS vs uniform along CDS: D={ks.statistic:.3f}, p={ks.pvalue:.3g}")

k=int((pos>=nmd_escape).sum()); frac=(CDS-nmd_escape+1)/CDS
bt=stats.binomtest(k,len(pos),frac,alternative='less')
print(f"NMD-escape region = {frac*100:.1f}% of CDS; observed {k}, expected {len(pos)*frac:.1f} (O/E={k/(len(pos)*frac):.2f}); one-sided binomial p={bt.pvalue:.4f}")

obs=[int(((pos>bounds[i])&(pos<=bounds[i+1])).sum()) for i in range(10)]
exp=[len(pos)*l/CDS for l in cds_len]
chi=stats.chisquare(obs,f_exp=exp)
print("obs per coding exon:",obs)
print("exp per coding exon:",[round(x,1) for x in exp])
print(f"chi2={chi.statistic:.2f}, df=9, p={chi.pvalue:.4f}")

fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(12,7.4),gridspec_kw={"height_ratios":[1.2,1]})
ax=axes[0]
ax.hist(pos,bins=np.arange(0,CDS+41,40),color="#2b6cb0",edgecolor="white")
for b in cum[:-1]: ax.axvline(b,color="#cbd5e0",lw=0.8)
top=ax.get_ylim()[1]
ax.axvspan(nmd_escape,CDS,color="#c53030",alpha=0.15)
ax.text((nmd_escape+CDS)/2,top*0.78,f"NMD-escape zone\n{k} obs vs {len(pos)*frac:.1f} exp",ha="center",fontsize=8,color="#742a2a")
ax.axvspan(319,342,color="#2f855a",alpha=0.3)
ax.text(331,top*0.92,"Walker A\naa 107-114",ha="center",fontsize=8,color="#22543d")
ax.set_xlabel("Position in RAD51D coding sequence (NM_002878.4, nt)")
ax.set_ylabel("Truncating\nP/LP alleles")
ax.set_title(f"A. Pathogenic truncating RAD51D alleles span the whole coding sequence (n = {len(pos)} unique alleles)",fontsize=11)
ax.spines[["top","right"]].set_visible(False)

ax=axes[1]
x=np.arange(10)
ax.bar(x-0.2,obs,0.4,label="observed",color="#2b6cb0")
ax.bar(x+0.2,exp,0.4,label="expected from exon length",color="#a0aec0")
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels([f"ex{i+1}\n{cds_len[i]}nt" for i in range(10)],fontsize=8)
ax.set_ylabel("Truncating alleles")
ax.set_title(f"B. Per-exon counts track exon length (chi2 = {chi.statistic:.1f}, df = 9, p = {chi.pvalue:.3f})",fontsize=11)
ax.legend(frameon=False); ax.spines[["top","right"]].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
